pkgmetadata.longdescription: Venus Pro Config is a reverse-engineered Linux configuration utility for the UtechSmart Venus Pro MMO mouse family: button remapping, hardware macros, RGB lighting, DPI stages, polling rate and a battery tray icon for the Areson (25a7:fa07/fa08) and Holtek (04d9:fc55) controllers. Two interfaces share one protocol layer and are selected at build time: the upstream Qt Widgets window and a dense QindaTK (Qt Quick) window for the QindaQt desktop. The launcher prefers the QindaTK interface when both are installed.

use.flag: Install the QindaTK (Qt Quick) interface built on dev-libs/qindatk
Install the upstream Qt Widgets interface
Enable the USB device reclaim action through dev-python/pyusb
